amends: A2_bounded_resource_resume_20261028 retry eligibility for this one identified guard implementation defect only; no budget increase
data_state: The first resumed health gate stopped after 11 child launches. Ten completed rows and one quarantined row are engineering evidence only. No S1 primary measurements exist at this decision.

incident.incident_identity: nvidia-smi retained this same PID with process_name='[No data]' and 386 MiB, while the existing executable-based /proc identity function returned no identity; total selected-GPU memory was 529 MiB.
incident.independent_review: Reviewed the complete local guard and incident JSONL: 11 registrations and launches, 10 clean run-end events, one incident naming only the just-registered child, followed by its successful return. This supports an exit/driver-listing race in ownership resolution. The old missing-identity observation is not retroactively relabeled clean and does not prove a general absence of interference between polls.

allowed_fix.scope: Python GPU guard ownership resolution for an already registered direct benchmark child at process exit; no CUDA harness, kernel, numerical threshold or measurement-binary change.
allowed_fix.identity_requirement: Bind any exit exception to the registered Popen object, PID, PPID and process start_ticks. A live process with a mismatching identity is foreign. A known child with no executable may be recognized only by independently observed terminal /proc state Z/X with matching PPID/start_ticks, or by a bounded recheck proving that the registered Popen child has exited without a conflicting live identity.
allowed_fix.bounded_recheck: Any exit-resolution grace must have an explicit short hard deadline and be logged. Absence of identity by itself, an old PID, a process name, or an elapsed timeout never establishes ownership. Failure to prove exit by the deadline remains fail-closed.
allowed_fix.unchanged_guards: Unknown or unregistered compute PIDs, PID reuse, mismatching executable/parent/start time, monitoring errors and the 2048-MiB budget remain enforced. Do not touch another user's process.
allowed_fix.verification: Record changed controller/guard hashes and run CPU-only tests covering terminal registered children, bounded return-code recheck, unknown PID rejection, live/mismatched identity rejection and unchanged memory-cap enforcement before the next GPU gate.

remaining_attempt.authorization: Root approved correction of this observed implementation defect within the user's explicit continuation request and the remaining finite A2 budget.
remaining_attempt.row_policy: Preserve all original records and quarantine labels; do not splice or promote any of these 11 processes into the next health gate or primary estimates. Run all 30 new processes under the fixed health protocol.
remaining_attempt.exhaustion: This consumes the only remaining A2 gate once its first child launches. A further health-quality, unresolved monitoring or competition stop ends this resumed attempt; this addendum grants no third new gate.

unchanged: A2's total two-started-gate limit and three zero-launch resource-refusal limit, the original 36x26 research matrix, S1/S2/S3/S4 budgets, A3 selection rules, all numerical and inferential thresholds, and H4 auxiliary-only status.
